leadText: Pokémon Pocket Comics: Sun & Moon (Japanese: ポケモン　レッツゴー！　だじゃれクラブ Pokémon: Let's Go! Pun Club) is a Pokémon 4Koma created by 春風邪三太 Santa Harukaze. It was serialized in the Pokémon Fan magazine as (Japanese: ポケモン超だじゃれクラブ Pokémon Super Pun Club). It is 192 pages long.
